lane: لَيَابٌ A quantity of food less than what fills the mouth: (IAar, K:) or a spoonful, that is chewed, or to be chewed. (K, and said to be on the authority of IAar.) Mentioned by IM in art. لوب, and again in the present art. (TA.)

entries.text: اللياب، كسحاب: أقل من ملء الفم من الطعام، أو قدر لعقة منه تلاك.
